## Earnie 2.5.3-alpha.4

Community **pre-release** of the **2.5.3** line (follow-up to `2.5.3-alpha.3`). Focus: Home Assistant **Add-on 0.2** — Ingress-first UI and Options→`config.json`.

### Highlights

- **Ingress** — `ingress: true` / `ingress_port: 8501`; OPEN WEB UI / sidebar without host `:8501` lookup; Streamlit `baseUrlPath` from Supervisor `ingress_entry`
- **Options → config.json** — fresh add-on install seeds `ehal.backend=ha`; `streamlit_port` / `ehal_loxone_http_port` merge into `config.json` each start (`runtime_store/addon_options.py`)
- Host port `8501` remains optional for advanced/direct LAN access
- **Dogfood pending** on Synology HAOS-in-VM (native Streamlit Ingress; nginx contingency only if that fails)

### Docker images

- `ghcr.io/jochentcc/earnie-energy:2.5.3-alpha.4` only (**no** `:latest`)
- Alpha compose: `docker/compose/synology-alpha.yml` / `loxberry-alpha.yml` / `proxmox-alpha.yml` (already pin this tag)

Multi-arch: `linux/amd64` (Synology / Proxmox) · `linux/arm64` (LoxBerry).

```bash
docker compose --project-directory . -f docker/compose/synology-alpha.yml pull
docker compose --project-directory . -f docker/compose/synology-alpha.yml up -d
```

Prod `*_productive.yml` with `:latest` stays on the last official (**2.5.2**).
